LEFT JOIN tb_exam e ON sc.exam_id = e.id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_batch eb ON e.exam_batch_id = eb.id
LEFT JOIN tb_school sch ON sc.school_id = sch.id
), labeled AS (
SELECT *, CASE WHEN score_value IS NULL OR full_score IS NULL OR full_score<=0
                       OR score_value<0 OR score_value>full_score THEN NULL

       COUNT(*) AS band_count
FROM labeled
GROUP BY exam_batch_id,exam_name,school_id,school_name,subject,score_band

FROM tb_score sc
LEFT JOIN tb_exam e ON sc.exam_id = e.id

LEFT JOIN tb_school sch ON sc.school_id = sch.id
), school_stats AS (

       COUNT(score_value) AS school_count,AVG(score_value) AS school_avg

views.name: v_school_observed_item_performance
views.statement:
WITH items AS (
SELECT sd.id AS detail_id, sd.exam_id AS paper_id, sd.student_id,

       e.subject, sd.question_id, sd.question_no, eq.question_type,

       CAST(COALESCE(eq.question_score,sd.question_score) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS item_full_score
FROM tb_score_detail sd
JOIN tb_score sc ON sd.exam_id=sc.exam_id AND sd.student_id=sc.student_id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam e ON sd.exam_id=e.id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_batch eb ON e.exam_batch_id=eb.id

)
SELECT exam_batch_id,exam_name,paper_id,school_id,school_name,subject,
       question_id,question_no,question_type,item_full_score,
       COUNT(item_score) AS observed_count,ROUND(AVG(item_score),2) AS average_item_score,
       ROUND(100.0*AVG(item_score)/NULLIF(item_full_score,0),2) AS score_rate,
       ROUND(1.0-AVG(item_score)/NULLIF(item_full_score,0),4) AS difficulty_index

views.statement:
WITH weights AS (
  SELECT question_id, knowledge_id,
         CAST(weight AS DOUBLE) /
         NULLIF(SUM(CAST(weight AS DOUBLE)) OVER (PARTITION BY question_id),0) AS normalized_weight
  FROM tb_exam_question_knowledge
  WHERE weight > 0
), items AS (
SELECT sd.id AS detail_id, sd.exam_id AS paper_id, sd.student_id,
       e.exam_batch_id, eb.batch_name AS exam_name,
       sc.school_id, sch.s_name AS school_name, sc."class" AS class_name,
       e.subject, sd.question_id, sd.question_no, eq.question_type,
       CAST(sd.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS item_score,
       CAST(COALESCE(eq.question_score,sd.question_score) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS item_full_score
FROM tb_score_detail sd
JOIN tb_score sc ON sd.exam_id=sc.exam_id AND sd.student_id=sc.student_id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam e ON sd.exam_id=e.id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_batch eb ON e.exam_batch_id=eb.id
LEFT JOIN tb_school sch ON sc.school_id=sch.id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_question eq ON sd.question_id=eq.id AND sd.exam_id=eq.exam_id
)
SELECT i.exam_batch_id, i.exam_name, i.school_id, i.school_name, i.subject,
       w.knowledge_id, COALESCE(k.knowledge_name,'未关联知识点') AS knowledge_name,
       k.ability_level,
       COUNT(DISTINCT i.question_id) AS question_count,
       COUNT(*) AS observed_item_count,
       SUM(i.item_score*COALESCE(w.normalized_weight,1)) AS weighted_score,
       SUM(i.item_full_score*COALESCE(w.normalized_weight,1)) AS weighted_full_score,
       ROUND(100.0*SUM(i.item_score*COALESCE(w.normalized_weight,1)) /
             NULLIF(SUM(i.item_full_score*COALESCE(w.normalized_weight,1)),0),2) AS mastery_rate
FROM items i
LEFT JOIN weights w ON i.question_id=w.question_id
LEFT JOIN tb_knowledge k ON w.knowledge_id=k.id
WHERE i.item_score IS NOT NULL AND i.item_full_score > 0
GROUP BY i.exam_batch_id, i.exam_name, i.school_id, i.school_name, i.subject,
         w.knowledge_id, k.knowledge_name, k.ability_level

-- V27 达线较上场变化：SQL草案，尚待业务确认。
-- 使用原始tb_*逻辑模型；本次未查询真实业务库。
-- 草案口径：前场按同届+考试类型+归属学校内时间排序，相同日期按ID稳定排序
-- 草案口径：某校没参加该前场时留NULL，不自动跳到更早一次
-- 草案口径：缺届次/日期不比较；阈值变化返回提示
WITH batches AS (
 SELECT id AS exam_batch_id,batch_name,exam_time,CAST(jc AS VARCHAR) AS cohort_year,exam_type,school_id,
 CASE WHEN jc IS NULL OR exam_time IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE
 LAG(id) OVER(PARTITION BY jc,exam_type,school_id ORDER BY exam_time,id) END AS previous_batch_id
 FROM tb_exam_batch WHERE jc IS NOT NULL AND CAST(jc AS VARCHAR)<>'' AND exam_time IS NOT NULL
), aggregated AS (
SELECT exam_batch_id,school_id,school_name,district,track,line_code,line_name,
 SUM(candidates) AS candidate_count,SUM(reached_count) AS reached_count,
 MIN(CAST(threshold AS DOUBLE)) AS min_threshold,MAX(CAST(threshold AS DOUBLE)) AS max_threshold
FROM tb_score_indicator GROUP BY exam_batch_id,school_id,school_name,district,track,line_code,line_name
), compared AS (
SELECT a.*,b.previous_batch_id,b.cohort_year,p.candidate_count AS previous_candidates,
 p.reached_count AS previous_count,p.min_threshold AS previous_min_threshold,p.max_threshold AS previous_max_threshold,
 ROUND(100.0*a.reached_count/NULLIF(a.candidate_count,0),2) AS current_rate,
 ROUND(100.0*p.reached_count/NULLIF(p.candidate_count,0),2) AS previous_rate
FROM aggregated a LEFT JOIN batches b ON a.exam_batch_id=b.exam_batch_id
LEFT JOIN aggregated p ON p.exam_batch_id=b.previous_batch_id AND p.school_id=a.school_id AND p.track=a.track AND p.line_code=a.line_code
)
SELECT *,reached_count AS current_count,reached_count-previous_count AS count_delta,
 ROUND(current_rate-previous_rate,2) AS rate_delta_pp,
 CASE WHEN min_threshold=max_threshold AND previous_min_threshold=previous_max_threshold AND min_threshold=previous_min_threshold THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS threshold_change_or_unknown
FROM compared

 ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY o.exam_batch_id,o.track,l.line_code ORDER BY o.total6,o.student_id,o.overview_id) AS reached_position
FROM ov o JOIN cutoff_lines l ON o.exam_batch_id=l.exam_batch_id AND o.track=l.track
WHERE o.student_status='在籍生' AND o.total6>=l.threshold AND l.threshold>0
), chosen AS (
SELECT * FROM line_members WHERE (exact_count>0 AND total6=threshold) OR (exact_count=0 AND reached_position=1)
), contributions AS (
SELECT c.exam_batch_id,c.exam_name,c.track,c.line_code,c.line_name,c.threshold,s.subject,s.score_type,
 AVG(s.comparable_score) AS contribution_score,COUNT(s.comparable_score) AS sample_count,
 MAX(CASE WHEN c.exact_count>0 THEN 'exact_cutoff_students' ELSE 'one_lowest_reached_student' END) AS sample_policy
FROM chosen c JOIN subject_rows s ON c.overview_id=s.overview_id
WHERE s.selected_flag=1 AND s.comparable_score IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.exam_batch_id,c.exam_name,c.track,c.line_code,c.line_name,c.threshold,s.subject,s.score_type
)
SELECT * FROM contributions

views.statement:
-- V29 题型平均得分率：SQL草案，尚待业务确认。
-- 使用原始tb_*逻辑模型；本次未查询真实业务库。
-- 草案口径：同时输出每题等权平均与分值/观测人数加权的两种得分率
-- 草案口径：仅已记录非空题成绩，缺行不补零；满分非正排除
-- 草案口径：不同班级独立输出，合并时回到底表重算
WITH items AS (
SELECT sd.id AS detail_id, sd.exam_id AS paper_id, sd.student_id,
       e.exam_batch_id, eb.batch_name AS exam_name,
       sc.school_id, sch.s_name AS school_name, sc."class" AS class_name,
       e.subject, sd.question_id, sd.question_no, eq.question_type,
       CAST(sd.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS item_score,
       CAST(COALESCE(eq.question_score,sd.question_score) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS item_full_score
FROM tb_score_detail sd
JOIN tb_score sc ON sd.exam_id=sc.exam_id AND sd.student_id=sc.student_id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam e ON sd.exam_id=e.id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_batch eb ON e.exam_batch_id=eb.id
LEFT JOIN tb_school sch ON sc.school_id=sch.id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_question eq ON sd.question_id=eq.id AND sd.exam_id=eq.exam_id
), per_question AS (
SELECT exam_batch_id,exam_name,paper_id,school_id,school_name,class_name,subject,question_id,question_no,
 question_type,item_full_score,COUNT(item_score) AS observed_count,
 SUM(item_score) AS score_sum,COUNT(item_score)*item_full_score AS full_sum,
 AVG(item_score)/NULLIF(item_full_score,0)*100.0 AS question_rate
FROM items WHERE item_score IS NOT NULL AND item_full_score>0
GROUP BY exam_batch_id,exam_name,paper_id,school_id,school_name,class_name,subject,question_id,question_no,question_type,item_full_score
)
SELECT exam_batch_id,exam_name,paper_id,school_id,school_name,class_name,subject,question_type,
 COUNT(*) AS question_count,SUM(observed_count) AS observed_count,
 ROUND(AVG(question_rate),2) AS mean_item_rate,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(score_sum)/NULLIF(SUM(full_sum),0),2) AS weighted_type_rate
FROM per_question GROUP BY exam_batch_id,exam_name,paper_id,school_id,school_name,class_name,subject,question_type

views.name: v_item_discrimination_curve
views.statement:
-- V30 题目区分度与难度曲线：SQL草案，尚待业务确认。
-- 使用原始tb_*逻辑模型；本次未查询真实业务库。
-- 草案口径：以有非空科目成绩的学生×本卷全部题目为底，缺小题行/NULL暂按0，须业务确认
-- 草案口径：高低27%按整科成绩顺序切组，同分按学生ID稳定；至少4人算区分度
-- 草案口径：discrimination以题满分为分母，legacy_discrimination同时保留旧个人总分分母；不可混称
WITH score_base AS (
SELECT sc.id AS score_id, sc.student_id, sc.exam_id AS paper_id,
       e.exam_batch_id, eb.batch_name AS exam_name, eb.exam_time AS exam_date,
       sc.school_id, sch.s_name AS school_name, sch.district,
       sch.type AS school_type, sc."class" AS class_name, e.subject,
       CAST(sc.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS score_value,
       CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS full_score,
       CASE WHEN sc.score IS NULL OR e.exam_score IS NULL
                      OR CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) <= 0 THEN NULL
            WHEN CAST(sc.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) >= CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) * 0.60
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pass_flag
FROM tb_score sc
LEFT JOIN tb_exam e ON sc.exam_id = e.id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_batch eb ON e.exam_batch_id = eb.id
LEFT JOIN tb_school sch ON sc.school_id = sch.id
), ranked_students AS (
SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY paper_id,school_id ORDER BY score_value DESC,student_id,score_id) AS student_position,
 COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY paper_id,school_id) AS student_pool_count
FROM score_base WHERE score_value IS NOT NULL AND score_value>=0
), spine AS (
SELECT s.*,q.id AS question_id,q.question_no,q.question_type,
 CAST(q.question_score AS DOUBLE) AS item_full_score,
 CAST(COALESCE(d.score,0) AS DOUBLE) AS item_score,
 CASE WHEN s.score_value=0 THEN 0 ELSE FLOOR((FLOOR(s.score_value)-1)/10)*10+1 END AS score_band
FROM ranked_students s JOIN tb_exam_question q ON s.paper_id=q.exam_id
LEFT JOIN tb_score_detail d ON d.exam_id=s.paper_id AND d.student_id=s.student_id AND d.question_id=q.id
WHERE CAST(q.question_score AS DOUBLE)>0
), bands AS (
SELECT exam_batch_id,exam_name,paper_id,school_id,school_name,subject,question_id,question_no,score_band,
 COUNT(*) AS student_count,AVG(item_score/item_full_score)*100.0 AS item_score_rate
FROM spine GROUP BY exam_batch_id,exam_name,paper_id,school_id,school_name,subject,question_id,question_no,score_band
), band_order AS (
SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY paper_id,school_id,question_id ORDER BY score_band) AS ascending_band,
 ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY paper_id,school_id,question_id ORDER BY score_band DESC) AS descending_band
FROM bands
), extrema AS (
SELECT paper_id,school_id,question_id,COUNT(*) AS band_count,
 MAX(CASE WHEN ascending_band=1 THEN item_score_rate ELSE NULL END) AS low_band_rate,
 MAX(CASE WHEN descending_band=1 THEN item_score_rate ELSE NULL END) AS high_band_rate
FROM band_order GROUP BY paper_id,school_id,question_id
), discrimination AS (
SELECT paper_id,school_id,question_id,MAX(student_pool_count) AS pool_count,
 AVG(CASE WHEN student_position<=GREATEST(1,FLOOR(student_pool_count*0.27)) THEN item_score/item_full_score ELSE NULL END) AS high_item_ratio,
 AVG(CASE WHEN student_position>student_pool_count-GREATEST(1,FLOOR(student_pool_count*0.27)) THEN item_score/item_full_score ELSE NULL END) AS low_item_ratio,
 AVG(CASE WHEN student_position<=GREATEST(1,FLOOR(student_pool_count*0.27)) THEN item_score/NULLIF(CAST(score_value AS DOUBLE),0) ELSE NULL END) AS high_legacy_ratio,
 AVG(CASE WHEN student_position>student_pool_count-GREATEST(1,FLOOR(student_pool_count*0.27)) THEN item_score/NULLIF(CAST(score_value AS DOUBLE),0) ELSE NULL END) AS low_legacy_ratio
FROM spine GROUP BY paper_id,school_id,question_id
)
SELECT b.*,ROUND(b.item_score_rate,2) AS score_rate,
 CASE WHEN e.band_count>=2 THEN ROUND(e.high_band_rate-e.low_band_rate,2) ELSE NULL END AS high_low_delta_pp,
 CASE WHEN d.pool_count>=4 THEN ROUND(100.0*(d.high_item_ratio-d.low_item_ratio),2) ELSE NULL END AS discrimination,
 CASE WHEN d.pool_count>=4 THEN ROUND(100.0*(d.high_legacy_ratio-d.low_legacy_ratio),2) ELSE NULL END AS legacy_discrimination,
 'missing_item_as_zero' AS missing_policy
FROM bands b JOIN extrema e ON b.paper_id=e.paper_id AND b.school_id=e.school_id AND b.question_id=e.question_id
JOIN discrimination d ON b.paper_id=d.paper_id AND b.school_id=d.school_id AND b.question_id=d.question_id

views.name: v_ability_knowledge_profile
views.statement:
-- V31 能力层级知识点画像：SQL草案，尚待业务确认。
-- 使用原始tb_*逻辑模型；本次未查询真实业务库。
-- 草案口径：班级内独立汇总；等权知识点平均与分值加权能力率分开输出
-- 草案口径：知识掌握按V16成对非空记录口径，缺行不补零
-- 草案口径：薄弱60为源码默认，unknown层级保留
WITH knowledge_stats AS (
WITH weights AS (
  SELECT question_id, knowledge_id,
         CAST(weight AS DOUBLE) /
         NULLIF(SUM(CAST(weight AS DOUBLE)) OVER (PARTITION BY question_id),0) AS normalized_weight
  FROM tb_exam_question_knowledge
  WHERE weight > 0
), items AS (
SELECT sd.id AS detail_id, sd.exam_id AS paper_id, sd.student_id,
       e.exam_batch_id, eb.batch_name AS exam_name,
       sc.school_id, sch.s_name AS school_name, sc."class" AS class_name,
       e.subject, sd.question_id, sd.question_no, eq.question_type,
       CAST(sd.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS item_score,
       CAST(COALESCE(eq.question_score,sd.question_score) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS item_full_score
FROM tb_score_detail sd
JOIN tb_score sc ON sd.exam_id=sc.exam_id AND sd.student_id=sc.student_id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam e ON sd.exam_id=e.id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_batch eb ON e.exam_batch_id=eb.id
LEFT JOIN tb_school sch ON sc.school_id=sch.id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_question eq ON sd.question_id=eq.id AND sd.exam_id=eq.exam_id
)
SELECT i.exam_batch_id, i.exam_name, i.school_id, i.school_name, i.class_name, i.subject,
       w.knowledge_id, COALESCE(k.knowledge_name,'未关联知识点') AS knowledge_name,
       k.ability_level,
       COUNT(DISTINCT i.question_id) AS question_count,
       COUNT(*) AS observed_item_count,
       SUM(i.item_score*COALESCE(w.normalized_weight,1)) AS weighted_score,
       SUM(i.item_full_score*COALESCE(w.normalized_weight,1)) AS weighted_full_score,
       ROUND(100.0*SUM(i.item_score*COALESCE(w.normalized_weight,1)) /
             NULLIF(SUM(i.item_full_score*COALESCE(w.normalized_weight,1)),0),2) AS mastery_rate
FROM items i
LEFT JOIN weights w ON i.question_id=w.question_id
LEFT JOIN tb_knowledge k ON w.knowledge_id=k.id
WHERE i.item_score IS NOT NULL AND i.item_full_score > 0
GROUP BY i.exam_batch_id, i.exam_name, i.school_id, i.school_name, i.class_name, i.subject,
         w.knowledge_id, k.knowledge_name, k.ability_level
)
SELECT exam_batch_id,exam_name,school_id,school_name,class_name,subject,
 COALESCE(ability_level,'unknown') AS ability_level,COUNT(*) AS knowledge_count,
 ROUND(AVG(mastery_rate),2) AS mean_knowledge_rate,
 SUM(CASE WHEN mastery_rate<60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weak_knowledge_count,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(weighted_score)/NULLIF(SUM(weighted_full_score),0),2) AS weighted_ability_rate,
 60.0 AS weak_threshold
FROM knowledge_stats GROUP BY exam_batch_id,exam_name,school_id,school_name,class_name,subject,ability_level

views.name: v_knowledge_cohort_gap
views.statement:
-- V32 后十名与中位组知识点差距：SQL草案，尚待业务确认。
-- 使用原始tb_*逻辑模型；本次未查询真实业务库。
-- 草案口径：每份试卷同校同班排序，真实0保留，后10和中位名次±2
-- 草案口径：顺序分组不扩同分；允许小班重叠并输出overlap_count
-- 草案口径：仅已有非空小题记录成对计算，不对缺行补0
WITH score_base AS (
SELECT sc.id AS score_id, sc.student_id, sc.exam_id AS paper_id,
       e.exam_batch_id, eb.batch_name AS exam_name, eb.exam_time AS exam_date,
       sc.school_id, sch.s_name AS school_name, sch.district,
       sch.type AS school_type, sc."class" AS class_name, e.subject,
       CAST(sc.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS score_value,
       CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS full_score,
       CASE WHEN sc.score IS NULL OR e.exam_score IS NULL
                      OR CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) <= 0 THEN NULL
            WHEN CAST(sc.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) >= CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) * 0.60
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pass_flag
FROM tb_score sc
LEFT JOIN tb_exam e ON sc.exam_id = e.id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_batch eb ON e.exam_batch_id = eb.id
LEFT JOIN tb_school sch ON sc.school_id = sch.id
), ranked AS (
SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY paper_id,school_id,class_name ORDER BY score_value DESC,student_id,score_id) AS position_no,
 COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY paper_id,school_id,class_name) AS pool_count
FROM score_base WHERE score_value IS NOT NULL AND class_name IS NOT NULL
), cohorts AS (
SELECT *,CASE WHEN position_no>pool_count-LEAST(10,pool_count) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bottom_flag,
 CASE WHEN position_no BETWEEN GREATEST(1,FLOOR((pool_count+1)/2.0)-2) AND LEAST(pool_count,FLOOR((pool_count+1)/2.0)+2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS median_flag
FROM ranked
), cohort_counts AS (
SELECT paper_id,school_id,class_name,SUM(bottom_flag) AS bottom_count,SUM(median_flag) AS median_count,
 SUM(CASE WHEN bottom_flag=1 AND median_flag=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overlap_count
FROM cohorts GROUP BY paper_id,school_id,class_name
), weights AS (
SELECT question_id,knowledge_id,CAST(weight AS DOUBLE)/NULLIF(SUM(CAST(weight AS DOUBLE)) OVER(PARTITION BY question_id),0) AS w
FROM tb_exam_question_knowledge WHERE weight>0
), per_knowledge AS (
SELECT c.exam_batch_id,c.exam_name,c.paper_id,c.school_id,c.school_name,c.class_name,c.subject,
 w.knowledge_id,COALESCE(k.knowledge_name,'未关联知识点') AS knowledge_name,
 SUM(CASE WHEN c.bottom_flag=1 THEN CAST(d.score AS DOUBLE)*COALESCE(w.w,1) ELSE NULL END) AS bottom_score,
 SUM(CASE WHEN c.bottom_flag=1 THEN CAST(COALESCE(q.question_score,d.question_score) AS DOUBLE)*COALESCE(w.w,1) ELSE NULL END) AS bottom_full,
 SUM(CASE WHEN c.median_flag=1 THEN CAST(d.score AS DOUBLE)*COALESCE(w.w,1) ELSE NULL END) AS median_score,
 SUM(CASE WHEN c.median_flag=1 THEN CAST(COALESCE(q.question_score,d.question_score) AS DOUBLE)*COALESCE(w.w,1) ELSE NULL END) AS median_full
FROM cohorts c JOIN tb_score_detail d ON c.paper_id=d.exam_id AND c.student_id=d.student_id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_question q ON d.question_id=q.id AND d.exam_id=q.exam_id
LEFT JOIN weights w ON d.question_id=w.question_id LEFT JOIN tb_knowledge k ON w.knowledge_id=k.id
WHERE d.score IS NOT NULL AND CAST(COALESCE(q.question_score,d.question_score) AS DOUBLE)>0
GROUP BY c.exam_batch_id,c.exam_name,c.paper_id,c.school_id,c.school_name,c.class_name,c.subject,w.knowledge_id,k.knowledge_name
)
SELECT p.*,cc.bottom_count,cc.median_count,cc.overlap_count,
 ROUND(100.0*bottom_score/NULLIF(bottom_full,0),2) AS bottom_rate,
 ROUND(100.0*median_score/NULLIF(median_full,0),2) AS median_rate,
 ROUND(100.0*median_score/NULLIF(median_full,0)-100.0*bottom_score/NULLIF(bottom_full,0),2) AS gap_pp
FROM per_knowledge p JOIN cohort_counts cc ON p.paper_id=cc.paper_id AND p.school_id=cc.school_id AND p.class_name=cc.class_name

properties.displayName: 后十名与中位组知识点差距
properties.description: 后十名与中位组知识点差距。输出粒度：批次×班级×科目×知识点×比较组。同班单次科目分排序；后10与中位名次±2，分组内按加权得分/满分算率；gap中位−后十。 数据范围：学校、班级、科目、批次；组人数和中位带参数。空组返回NULL；百分率为0–100，分母为0返回NULL。 正式发布前需确认：并列是否扩组；小班两组重叠是否允许；学生去重；缺小题口径 本SQL草案采用：每份试卷同校同班排序，真实0保留，后10和中位名次±2；顺序分组不扩同分；允许小班重叠并输出overlap_count；仅已有非空小题记录成对计算，不对缺行补0。

views.name: v_class_peer_weak_subject
views.statement:

-- 使用原始tb_*逻辑模型；本次未查询真实业务库。
-- 草案口径：同校同年级同科、每班>=3个非空成绩；未识别年级不混排
-- 草案口径：对照各班均分等权且含本班；DENSE_RANK
-- 草案口径：逐卷满分60%及格、85%优秀，真实0保留；5分/后30%/后3名为待确认默认
WITH base AS (
SELECT sc.id AS score_id, sc.student_id, sc.exam_id AS paper_id,
       e.exam_batch_id, eb.batch_name AS exam_name, eb.exam_time AS exam_date,
       sc.school_id, sch.s_name AS school_name, sch.district,
       sch.type AS school_type, sc."class" AS class_name, e.subject,
       CAST(sc.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS score_value,
       CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS full_score,
       CASE WHEN sc.score IS NULL OR e.exam_score IS NULL
                      OR CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) <= 0 THEN NULL
            WHEN CAST(sc.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) >= CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) * 0.60
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pass_flag
FROM tb_score sc
LEFT JOIN tb_exam e ON sc.exam_id = e.id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_batch eb ON e.exam_batch_id = eb.id
LEFT JOIN tb_school sch ON sc.school_id = sch.id
), graded AS (
SELECT *,CASE WHEN class_name LIKE '高一%' THEN '高一' WHEN class_name LIKE '高二%' THEN '高二' WHEN class_name LIKE '高三%' THEN '高三' WHEN class_name LIKE '初一%' THEN '初一' WHEN class_name LIKE '初二%' THEN '初二' WHEN class_name LIKE '初三%' THEN '初三' ELSE NULL END AS grade,
 CASE WHEN score_value IS NULL OR full_score IS NULL OR full_score<=0 THEN NULL WHEN score_value>=full_score*0.85 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS excellent_flag
FROM base
), class_stats AS (
SELECT exam_batch_id,exam_name,school_id,school_name,grade,class_name,subject,
 COUNT(score_value) AS n,AVG(score_value) AS class_avg,
 STDDEV_SAMP(CAST(score_value AS DOUBLE)) AS class_stdev,MAX(score_value)-MIN(score_value) AS score_range,
 100.0*SUM(pass_flag)/NULLIF(COUNT(pass_flag),0) AS pass_rate,
 100.0*SUM(excellent_flag)/NULLIF(COUNT(excellent_flag),0) AS excellent_rate
FROM graded WHERE grade IS NOT NULL AND class_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY exam_batch_id,exam_name,school_id,school_name,grade,class_name,subject
), ranked AS (
SELECT *,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY exam_batch_id,school_id,grade,subject ORDER BY class_avg DESC) AS dense_rank,
 COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY exam_batch_id,school_id,grade,subject) AS class_count,
 AVG(class_avg) OVER(PARTITION BY exam_batch_id,school_id,grade,subject) AS peer_avg
FROM class_stats WHERE n>=3
)
SELECT *,ROUND(peer_avg-class_avg,2) AS avg_gap,
 CASE WHEN dense_rank>CEIL(class_count*0.70) OR peer_avg-class_avg>=5
 OR (class_count>=10 AND dense_rank>class_count-3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS weak_flag
FROM ranked

properties.displayName: 同校班际薄弱学科
properties.description: 同校班际薄弱学科。输出粒度：批次×学校×年级×班级×科目。旧对照为各班均分等权且含本班；DENSE_RANK；后30%或低于对照>=5分或>=10班时后3名命中。 数据范围：先筛同校同年级同科，班至少3人。空组返回NULL；百分率为0–100，分母为0返回NULL。 正式发布前需确认：等权班均还是学生加权、对照含不含本班；满分处理；0分；各阈值是否认可 本SQL草案采用：同校同年级同科、每班>=3个非空成绩；未识别年级不混排；对照各班均分等权且含本班；DENSE_RANK；逐卷满分60%及格、85%优秀，真实0保留；5分/后30%/后3名为待确认默认。

views.name: v_group_intervention_profile
views.statement:
-- V34 群体特征与干预优先级：SQL草案，尚待业务确认。
-- 使用原始tb_*逻辑模型；本次未查询真实业务库。
-- 草案口径：同校同年级科目，基准为学生加权；班级>=3
-- 草案口径：分数差只和分数标准差比，率差用百分点阈值，修正旧单位混比
-- 草案口径：±3分、1.15倍、落后5分/5pp、60%和优先级加权为待确认默认；小题仅已有非空记录
WITH base AS (
SELECT sc.id AS score_id, sc.student_id, sc.exam_id AS paper_id,
       e.exam_batch_id, eb.batch_name AS exam_name, eb.exam_time AS exam_date,
       sc.school_id, sch.s_name AS school_name, sch.district,
       sch.type AS school_type, sc."class" AS class_name, e.subject,
       CAST(sc.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS score_value,
       CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS full_score,
       CASE WHEN sc.score IS NULL OR e.exam_score IS NULL
                      OR CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) <= 0 THEN NULL
            WHEN CAST(sc.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) >= CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) * 0.60
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pass_flag
FROM tb_score sc
LEFT JOIN tb_exam e ON sc.exam_id = e.id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_batch eb ON e.exam_batch_id = eb.id
LEFT JOIN tb_school sch ON sc.school_id = sch.id
), graded AS (
SELECT *,CASE WHEN class_name LIKE '高一%' THEN '高一' WHEN class_name LIKE '高二%' THEN '高二' WHEN class_name LIKE '高三%' THEN '高三' WHEN class_name LIKE '初一%' THEN '初一' WHEN class_name LIKE '初二%' THEN '初二' WHEN class_name LIKE '初三%' THEN '初三' ELSE NULL END AS grade,
 CASE WHEN score_value IS NULL OR full_score IS NULL OR full_score<=0 THEN NULL WHEN score_value>=full_score*0.85 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS excellent_flag
FROM base
), class_stats AS (
SELECT exam_batch_id,exam_name,school_id,school_name,grade,class_name,subject,
 COUNT(score_value) AS n,AVG(score_value) AS class_avg,
 STDDEV_SAMP(CAST(score_value AS DOUBLE)) AS class_stdev,MAX(score_value)-MIN(score_value) AS score_range,
 100.0*SUM(pass_flag)/NULLIF(COUNT(pass_flag),0) AS pass_rate,
 100.0*SUM(excellent_flag)/NULLIF(COUNT(excellent_flag),0) AS excellent_rate
FROM graded WHERE grade IS NOT NULL AND class_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY exam_batch_id,exam_name,school_id,school_name,grade,class_name,subject
), school_stats AS (
SELECT exam_batch_id,school_id,grade,subject,AVG(score_value) AS school_avg,
 STDDEV_SAMP(CAST(score_value AS DOUBLE)) AS school_stdev,
 100.0*SUM(pass_flag)/NULLIF(COUNT(pass_flag),0) AS school_pass_rate
FROM graded WHERE grade IS NOT NULL GROUP BY exam_batch_id,school_id,grade,subject
), compared AS (
SELECT c.*,s.school_avg,s.school_stdev,s.school_pass_rate,
 c.class_avg-s.school_avg AS average_score_gap,c.pass_rate-s.school_pass_rate AS pass_rate_gap_pp,
 c.class_stdev/NULLIF(s.school_stdev,0) AS dispersion_ratio,
 CASE WHEN s.school_stdev>0 THEN CASE WHEN c.class_stdev>=s.school_stdev*1.15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN c.score_range>=GREATEST(30,ABS(s.school_avg)*0.35) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS high_dispersion
FROM class_stats c JOIN school_stats s ON c.exam_batch_id=s.exam_batch_id AND c.school_id=s.school_id AND c.grade=s.grade AND c.subject=s.subject
WHERE c.n>=3
), item_base AS (
SELECT sd.id AS detail_id, sd.exam_id AS paper_id, sd.student_id,
       e.exam_batch_id, eb.batch_name AS exam_name,
       sc.school_id, sch.s_name AS school_name, sc."class" AS class_name,
       e.subject, sd.question_id, sd.question_no, eq.question_type,
       CAST(sd.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS item_score,
       CAST(COALESCE(eq.question_score,sd.question_score) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS item_full_score
FROM tb_score_detail sd
JOIN tb_score sc ON sd.exam_id=sc.exam_id AND sd.student_id=sc.student_id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam e ON sd.exam_id=e.id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_batch eb ON e.exam_batch_id=eb.id
LEFT JOIN tb_school sch ON sc.school_id=sch.id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_question eq ON sd.question_id=eq.id AND sd.exam_id=eq.exam_id
), item_rates AS (
SELECT exam_batch_id,paper_id,school_id,class_name,subject,question_id,
 CASE WHEN class_name LIKE '高一%' THEN '高一' WHEN class_name LIKE '高二%' THEN '高二' WHEN class_name LIKE '高三%' THEN '高三' WHEN class_name LIKE '初一%' THEN '初一' WHEN class_name LIKE '初二%' THEN '初二' WHEN class_name LIKE '初三%' THEN '初三' ELSE NULL END AS grade,
 100.0*AVG(item_score)/NULLIF(MAX(item_full_score),0) AS item_rate
FROM item_base WHERE item_score IS NOT NULL AND item_full_score>0
GROUP BY exam_batch_id,paper_id,school_id,class_name,subject,question_id
), item_peers AS (
SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY exam_batch_id,paper_id,school_id,grade,question_id) AS peer_classes,
 (SUM(item_rate) OVER(PARTITION BY exam_batch_id,paper_id,school_id,grade,question_id)-item_rate)/
 NULLIF(COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY exam_batch_id,paper_id,school_id,grade,question_id)-1,0) AS peer_item_rate
FROM item_rates
), item_flags AS (
SELECT exam_batch_id,school_id,class_name,subject,
 SUM(CASE WHEN item_rate-peer_item_rate<=-8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lagging_item_count,
 SUM(CASE WHEN item_rate-peer_item_rate>-8 AND item_rate<60 AND peer_item_rate<60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS common_hard_item_count
FROM item_peers GROUP BY exam_batch_id,school_id,class_name,subject
)
SELECT c.*,
 CASE WHEN average_score_gap>=3 AND high_dispersion=0 THEN '优势均衡'
 WHEN average_score_gap>=3 THEN '优势两极' WHEN average_score_gap<=-3 AND high_dispersion=1 THEN '薄弱两极'
 WHEN average_score_gap<=-3 THEN '整体偏弱' WHEN high_dispersion=1 THEN '中间分化' ELSE '中间稳健' END AS feature_label,
 CASE WHEN average_score_gap < -5 OR (average_score_gap<0 AND ABS(average_score_gap)>school_stdev)
 OR pass_rate_gap_pp < -5 OR pass_rate<60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS intervention_flag,
 2*ABS(average_score_gap)+CASE WHEN pass_rate_gap_pp<0 THEN ABS(pass_rate_gap_pp) ELSE 0 END+
 CASE WHEN pass_rate<60 THEN 10 ELSE 0 END AS priority_score,
 COALESCE(i.lagging_item_count,0) AS lagging_item_count,COALESCE(i.common_hard_item_count,0) AS common_hard_item_count
FROM compared c LEFT JOIN item_flags i ON c.exam_batch_id=i.exam_batch_id AND c.school_id=i.school_id AND c.class_name=i.class_name AND c.subject=i.subject

properties.displayName: 群体特征与干预优先级
properties.description: 群体特征与干预优先级。输出粒度：批次×学校×班级×科目。原项目有±3分、标准差×1.15、低均分>5、低率>8pp等不同标签和优先级公式；题目落后<=−8pp、共同难题两率<60%。 数据范围：同校同年级科目；对照池参数；建议返回证据字段和标签。空组返回NULL；百分率为0–100，分母为0返回NULL。 正式发布前需确认：分与百分点不能共用分数标准差判显著；多个规则必须拆开标签字段，不静默混成一个阈值 本SQL草案采用：同校同年级科目，基准为学生加权；班级>=3；分数差只和分数标准差比，率差用百分点阈值，修正旧单位混比；±3分、1.15倍、落后5分/5pp、60%和优先级加权为待确认默认；小题仅已有非空记录。

views.name: v_subject_research_comparison
views.statement:
-- V35 教研整体、分卷和拖后腿小题：SQL草案，尚待业务确认。
-- 使用原始tb_*逻辑模型；本次未查询真实业务库。
-- 草案口径：仅在籍，排市报学校；OV学生批次键唯一是前提
-- 草案口径：校区按学校名前字母+两数字编码合并，无编码用school_id；混合校类需先修复
-- 草案口径：row_type分overall/section/item；原始整卷均分、分卷、小题在不同粒度，禁止混合SUM
-- 草案口径：有整科成绩的学生×试卷题目作底，缺小题暂补0；卷1/2题型沿用旧前缀，拖后腿2/3名门槛
WITH raw_base AS (
SELECT sc.id AS score_id, sc.student_id, sc.exam_id AS paper_id,
       e.exam_batch_id, eb.batch_name AS exam_name, eb.exam_time AS exam_date,
       sc.school_id, sch.s_name AS school_name, sch.district,
       sch.type AS school_type, sc."class" AS class_name, e.subject,
       CAST(sc.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS score_value,
       CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS full_score,
       CASE WHEN sc.score IS NULL OR e.exam_score IS NULL
                      OR CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) <= 0 THEN NULL
            WHEN CAST(sc.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) >= CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) * 0.60
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pass_flag
FROM tb_score sc
LEFT JOIN tb_exam e ON sc.exam_id = e.id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_batch eb ON e.exam_batch_id = eb.id
LEFT JOIN tb_school sch ON sc.school_id = sch.id
), research_base AS (
SELECT b.*,CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(b.school_name,'^[A-Za-z][0-9]{2}') THEN SUBSTRING(b.school_name,1,3) ELSE b.school_id END AS school_unit_id
FROM raw_base b JOIN tb_score_overview o ON b.student_id=o.anon_stu_id AND b.exam_batch_id=o.exam_batch_id
WHERE o.xsxz='在籍生' AND b.score_value IS NOT NULL
 AND (b.school_type IS NULL OR b.school_type NOT LIKE '%市报%')
), overall AS (
SELECT exam_batch_id,exam_name,subject,school_unit_id,MAX(school_type) AS school_type,
 COUNT(*) AS unit_n,AVG(CAST(score_value AS DOUBLE)) AS raw_average
FROM research_base GROUP BY exam_batch_id,exam_name,subject,school_unit_id
), ranked_overall AS (
SELECT *,RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY exam_batch_id,subject ORDER BY raw_average DESC) AS city_rank
FROM overall
), tier_stats AS (
SELECT exam_batch_id,subject,school_type,AVG(CAST(score_value AS DOUBLE)) AS tier_average
FROM research_base GROUP BY exam_batch_id,subject,school_type
), research_items AS (
SELECT b.*,q.id AS question_id,q.question_no,
 CASE WHEN q.question_type IS NULL OR q.question_type='' THEN 'other'
 WHEN q.question_type LIKE '单选题%' OR q.question_type LIKE '多选题%' OR q.question_type LIKE '听力%' OR q.question_type LIKE '阅读理解%' OR q.question_type LIKE '阅读%' OR q.question_type LIKE '完形填空%' OR q.question_type LIKE '七选五%' THEN 'paper1' ELSE 'paper2' END AS paper_section,
 CAST(COALESCE(d.score,0) AS DOUBLE) AS item_score
FROM research_base b JOIN tb_exam_question q ON b.paper_id=q.exam_id
LEFT JOIN tb_score_detail d ON d.exam_id=b.paper_id AND d.student_id=b.student_id AND d.question_id=q.id
), student_sections AS (
SELECT exam_batch_id,exam_name,subject,school_unit_id,student_id,paper_id,paper_section,SUM(item_score) AS section_score
FROM research_items WHERE paper_section IN ('paper1','paper2')
GROUP BY exam_batch_id,exam_name,subject,school_unit_id,student_id,paper_id,paper_section
), sections AS (
SELECT exam_batch_id,subject,school_unit_id,paper_section,AVG(section_score) AS section_average
FROM student_sections GROUP BY exam_batch_id,subject,school_unit_id,paper_section
), section_ranks AS (
SELECT *,RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY exam_batch_id,subject,paper_section ORDER BY section_average DESC) AS section_rank
FROM sections
), item_stats AS (
SELECT exam_batch_id,subject,school_unit_id,question_id,question_no,AVG(item_score) AS item_average
FROM research_items GROUP BY exam_batch_id,subject,school_unit_id,question_id,question_no
), item_ranks AS (
SELECT *,RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY exam_batch_id,subject,question_id ORDER BY item_average DESC) AS item_rank
FROM item_stats
), batches AS (
 SELECT id AS exam_batch_id,batch_name,exam_time,CAST(jc AS VARCHAR) AS cohort_year,exam_type,school_id,
 CASE WHEN jc IS NULL OR exam_time IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE
 LAG(id) OVER(PARTITION BY jc,exam_type,school_id ORDER BY exam_time,id) END AS previous_batch_id
 FROM tb_exam_batch WHERE jc IS NOT NULL AND CAST(jc AS VARCHAR)<>'' AND exam_time IS NOT NULL
), enriched AS (
SELECT r.*,t.tier_average,b.previous_batch_id,p.raw_average AS previous_average,p.city_rank AS previous_city_rank,p.city_rank-r.city_rank AS rank_change
FROM ranked_overall r LEFT JOIN tier_stats t ON r.exam_batch_id=t.exam_batch_id AND r.subject=t.subject
 AND COALESCE(r.school_type,'')=COALESCE(t.school_type,'')
LEFT JOIN batches b ON r.exam_batch_id=b.exam_batch_id
LEFT JOIN ranked_overall p ON p.exam_batch_id=b.previous_batch_id AND p.subject=r.subject AND p.school_unit_id=r.school_unit_id
)
SELECT e.*,'overall' AS row_type,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS paper_section,
 CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS section_average,CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS section_rank,
 CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS question_id,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS question_no,
 CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS item_average,CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS item_rank,
 CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS rank_lag,CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS lagging_flag
FROM enriched e
UNION ALL
SELECT e.*,'section',s.paper_section,s.section_average,s.section_rank,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL
FROM enriched e JOIN section_ranks s ON e.exam_batch_id=s.exam_batch_id AND e.subject=s.subject AND e.school_unit_id=s.school_unit_id
UNION ALL
SELECT e.*,'item',NULL,NULL,NULL,i.question_id,i.question_no,i.item_average,i.item_rank,i.item_rank-e.city_rank,
 CASE WHEN i.item_rank-e.city_rank>=CASE WHEN e.school_type LIKE '%引领%' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
FROM enriched e JOIN item_ranks i ON e.exam_batch_id=i.exam_batch_id AND e.subject=i.subject AND e.school_unit_id=i.school_unit_id

properties.displayName: 教研整体、分卷和拖后腿小题
properties.description: 教研整体、分卷和拖后腿小题。输出粒度：批次×学校合并单元×科目×卷部分/题目。教研整卷均分用原始tb_score；卷1由指定题型前缀归类，其余非空题型为卷2；先按生汇总再校均；拖后腿题排名落后整科排名>=2/3。 数据范围：本校及同层对照、在籍规则、同一批次科目。空组返回NULL；百分率为0–100，分母为0返回NULL。 正式发布前需确认：校区合并映射；分卷与总分学生集合一致；缺题补零；排名舍入；科目/层次门槛 本SQL草案采用：仅在籍，排市报学校；OV学生批次键唯一是前提；校区按学校名前字母+两数字编码合并，无编码用school_id；混合校类需先修复；row_type分overall/section/item；原始整卷均分、分卷、小题在不同粒度，禁止混合SUM；有整科成绩的学生×试卷题目作底，缺小题暂补0；卷1/2题型沿用旧前缀，拖后腿2/3名门槛。

views.name: v_research_focus_students
views.statement:
-- V36 尖子生与压线薄弱学生：SQL草案，尚待业务确认。
-- 使用原始tb_*逻辑模型；本次未查询真实业务库。
-- 草案口径：只输出匿名学生ID，三类名单独立list_type，跨名单不能直接相加人数
-- 草案口径：尖子生仅引领校、物理前100/历史前30含并列；尖子班按实际名单
-- 草案口径：压线保留旧科目特殊比较J12，但改用选科标识保留真实0，必须逐项确认
-- 草案口径：同一学生命中多条关注线时均保留线种，不沿用旧首条break；这是一项明确草案差异
WITH ov AS (
SELECT o.id AS overview_id,o.exam_batch_id,o.exam_name,
 o.anon_stu_id AS student_id,o.xx AS school_name,o.dq AS district,
 o.bj AS class_name,o.jc AS cohort_year,o.xsxz AS student_status,
 o.xxlb AS school_type,o.xkkm AS subject_combination,
 CASE WHEN o.xkkm LIKE '物%' THEN '物理类' WHEN o.xkkm LIKE '史%' OR o.xkkm LIKE '历%' THEN '历史类' ELSE NULL END AS track,
 CAST(o.zf3m AS DOUBLE) AS total3,CAST(o.zf4m AS DOUBLE) AS total4,
 CAST(o.zf6m AS DOUBLE) AS total6,
 CAST(o.yw AS DOUBLE) AS yw,CAST(o.sx AS DOUBLE) AS sx,CAST(o.yy AS DOUBLE) AS yy,
 CAST(o.wl AS DOUBLE) AS wl,CAST(o.ls AS DOUBLE) AS ls,
 CAST(o.hx AS DOUBLE) AS hx,CAST(o.sw AS DOUBLE) AS sw,CAST(o.zz AS DOUBLE) AS zz,CAST(o.dl AS DOUBLE) AS dl,
 CAST(o.hxzh AS DOUBLE) AS hxzh,CAST(o.swzh AS DOUBLE) AS swzh,
 CAST(o.zzzh AS DOUBLE) AS zzzh,CAST(o.dlzh AS DOUBLE) AS dlzh,
 o.hxdj,o.swdj,o.zzdj,o.dldj
FROM tb_score_overview o
), subject_rows AS (
SELECT overview_id,exam_batch_id,exam_name,student_id,school_name,district,class_name,cohort_year,student_status,school_type,subject_combination,track,'语文' AS subject,yw AS raw_score,CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS assigned_score,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS assigned_grade,'raw' AS score_type,yw AS comparable_score,1 AS selected_flag FROM ov
UNION ALL
SELECT overview_id,exam_batch_id,exam_name,student_id,school_name,district,class_name,cohort_year,student_status,school_type,subject_combination,track,'数学' AS subject,sx AS raw_score,CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS assigned_score,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS assigned_grade,'raw' AS score_type,sx AS comparable_score,1 AS selected_flag FROM ov
UNION ALL
SELECT overview_id,exam_batch_id,exam_name,student_id,school_name,district,class_name,cohort_year,student_status,school_type,subject_combination,track,'英语' AS subject,yy AS raw_score,CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS assigned_score,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS assigned_grade,'raw' AS score_type,yy AS comparable_score,1 AS selected_flag FROM ov
UNION ALL

views.name: v_student_score_trend
views.statement:
-- V37 学生历次成绩及进退步：SQL草案，尚待业务确认。
-- 使用原始tb_*逻辑模型；本次未查询真实业务库。
-- 草案口径：按同届+考试类型+归属学校的全局相邻批次，不按学生缺考后任意回溯
-- 草案口径：同一学生同科且满分相同才算原始分差；缺分、缺满分或跨满分留NULL并输出状态
-- 草案口径：只实现原始科目趋势，不冒充六门总分趋势；另给得分率差作为不同量纲
-- 草案口径：±5为本草案稳定带，学生±3/班均±0.5须作为其他指标另行定义
WITH score_base AS (
SELECT sc.id AS score_id, sc.student_id, sc.exam_id AS paper_id,
       e.exam_batch_id, eb.batch_name AS exam_name, eb.exam_time AS exam_date,
       sc.school_id, sch.s_name AS school_name, sch.district,
       sch.type AS school_type, sc."class" AS class_name, e.subject,
       CAST(sc.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS score_value,
       CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS full_score,
       CASE WHEN sc.score IS NULL OR e.exam_score IS NULL
                      OR CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) <= 0 THEN NULL
            WHEN CAST(sc.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) >= CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) * 0.60
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pass_flag
FROM tb_score sc
LEFT JOIN tb_exam e ON sc.exam_id = e.id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_batch eb ON e.exam_batch_id = eb.id
LEFT JOIN tb_school sch ON sc.school_id = sch.id
), batches AS (
 SELECT id AS exam_batch_id,batch_name,exam_time,CAST(jc AS VARCHAR) AS cohort_year,exam_type,school_id,
 CASE WHEN jc IS NULL OR exam_time IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE
 LAG(id) OVER(PARTITION BY jc,exam_type,school_id ORDER BY exam_time,id) END AS previous_batch_id
 FROM tb_exam_batch WHERE jc IS NOT NULL AND CAST(jc AS VARCHAR)<>'' AND exam_time IS NOT NULL
), paired AS (
SELECT c.*,b.cohort_year,b.previous_batch_id,p.score_value AS previous_score,p.full_score AS previous_full_score,
 CASE WHEN c.score_value IS NULL OR p.score_value IS NULL THEN 'missing_score'
 WHEN c.full_score IS NULL OR p.full_score IS NULL OR c.full_score<=0 OR p.full_score<=0 THEN 'missing_full_score'
 WHEN c.full_score<>p.full_score THEN 'different_full_score' ELSE 'comparable' END AS comparison_status
FROM score_base c LEFT JOIN batches b ON c.exam_batch_id=b.exam_batch_id
LEFT JOIN score_base p ON p.exam_batch_id=b.previous_batch_id AND p.student_id=c.student_id AND p.subject=c.subject
), trend AS (
SELECT *,CASE WHEN comparison_status='comparable' THEN score_value-previous_score ELSE NULL END AS delta_score,
 CASE WHEN score_value IS NOT NULL AND previous_score IS NOT NULL AND full_score>0 AND previous_full_score>0
 THEN ROUND(100.0*score_value/full_score-100.0*previous_score/previous_full_score,2) ELSE NULL END AS score_rate_delta_pp
FROM paired
)
SELECT *, 'raw_subject' AS score_type,score_value AS current_score,
 CASE WHEN delta_score IS NULL THEN 'unknown' WHEN delta_score>5 THEN 'progress' WHEN delta_score < -5 THEN 'regress' ELSE 'stable' END AS progress_band
FROM trend

views.name: v_student_multisubject_profile
views.statement:
-- V38 水平分层、偏科与相关性：SQL草案，尚待业务确认。
-- 使用原始tb_*逻辑模型；本次未查询真实业务库。
-- 草案口径：performance_band按单科实际满分判ABCD，不猜六门总满分
-- 草案口径：偏科度按同班各科顺序名次总体标准差，至少两科；不同选科参与集合影响解释
-- 草案口径：原始分差>=20且有不及格科只作legacy证据；不同满分不宣称已标准化
-- 草案口径：Pearson使用同学生成对非空记录；样本不足/零方差为NULL，不将相关性当因果
WITH raw_base AS (
SELECT sc.id AS score_id, sc.student_id, sc.exam_id AS paper_id,
       e.exam_batch_id, eb.batch_name AS exam_name, eb.exam_time AS exam_date,
       sc.school_id, sch.s_name AS school_name, sch.district,
       sch.type AS school_type, sc."class" AS class_name, e.subject,
       CAST(sc.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS score_value,
       CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS full_score,
       CASE WHEN sc.score IS NULL OR e.exam_score IS NULL
                      OR CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) <= 0 THEN NULL
            WHEN CAST(sc.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) >= CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) * 0.60
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pass_flag
FROM tb_score sc
LEFT JOIN tb_exam e ON sc.exam_id = e.id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_batch eb ON e.exam_batch_id = eb.id
LEFT JOIN tb_school sch ON sc.school_id = sch.id
), selected AS (
SELECT * FROM raw_base WHERE score_value IS NOT NULL AND full_score>0 AND class_name IS NOT NULL
), subject_ranks AS (
SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY exam_batch_id,school_id,class_name,subject ORDER BY score_value DESC,student_id,score_id) AS subject_rank,
 CASE WHEN score_value>=full_score*0.85 THEN 'A' WHEN score_value>=full_score*0.70 THEN 'B'
 WHEN score_value>=full_score*0.60 THEN 'C' ELSE 'D' END AS performance_band
FROM selected
), imbalance AS (
SELECT exam_batch_id,school_id,class_name,student_id,COUNT(*) AS subject_count,
 STDDEV_POP(CAST(subject_rank AS DOUBLE)) AS imbalance_degree,
 MAX(score_value)-MIN(score_value) AS raw_score_gap,
 MAX(CASE WHEN score_value<full_score*0.60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_failed_subject
FROM subject_ranks GROUP BY exam_batch_id,school_id,class_name,student_id
), pairs AS (
SELECT r.exam_batch_id,r.school_id,r.class_name,r.subject,
 COUNT(*) AS pair_count,STDDEV_POP(CAST(r.score_value AS DOUBLE)) AS subject_sd,STDDEV_POP(CAST(o.zf6m AS DOUBLE)) AS total_sd,CORR(CAST(r.score_value AS DOUBLE),CAST(o.zf6m AS DOUBLE)) AS pearson_r
FROM subject_ranks r JOIN tb_score_overview o ON r.exam_batch_id=o.exam_batch_id AND r.student_id=o.anon_stu_id
WHERE o.zf6m IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.exam_batch_id,r.school_id,r.class_name,r.subject
)
SELECT r.*,i.subject_count,CASE WHEN i.subject_count>=2 THEN ROUND(i.imbalance_degree,2) ELSE NULL END AS imbalance_degree,
 i.raw_score_gap,CASE WHEN i.subject_count>=2 AND i.raw_score_gap>=20 AND i.has_failed_subject=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS raw_gap_flag,
 p.pair_count,CASE WHEN p.pair_count>=2 AND p.subject_sd>0 AND p.total_sd>0 THEN ROUND(p.pearson_r,3) ELSE NULL END AS pearson_r
FROM subject_ranks r JOIN imbalance i ON r.exam_batch_id=i.exam_batch_id AND r.school_id=i.school_id AND r.class_name=i.class_name AND r.student_id=i.student_id
LEFT JOIN pairs p ON r.exam_batch_id=p.exam_batch_id AND r.school_id=p.school_id AND r.class_name=p.class_name AND r.subject=p.subject

-- 草案口径：版本字段显式为draft，不读取原系统运行配置；通知/确认/连续次数仍由应用实现
WITH score_base AS (
SELECT sc.id AS score_id, sc.student_id, sc.exam_id AS paper_id,
       e.exam_batch_id, eb.batch_name AS exam_name, eb.exam_time AS exam_date,
       sc.school_id, sch.s_name AS school_name, sch.district,
       sch.type AS school_type, sc."class" AS class_name, e.subject,
       CAST(sc.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS score_value,
       CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS full_score,
       CASE WHEN sc.score IS NULL OR e.exam_score IS NULL
                      OR CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) <= 0 THEN NULL
            WHEN CAST(sc.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) >= CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) * 0.60
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pass_flag
FROM tb_score sc
LEFT JOIN tb_exam e ON sc.exam_id = e.id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_batch eb ON e.exam_batch_id = eb.id
LEFT JOIN tb_school sch ON sc.school_id = sch.id
), batches AS (
 SELECT id AS exam_batch_id,batch_name,exam_time,CAST(jc AS VARCHAR) AS cohort_year,exam_type,school_id,
 CASE WHEN jc IS NULL OR exam_time IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE
 LAG(id) OVER(PARTITION BY jc,exam_type,school_id ORDER BY exam_time,id) END AS previous_batch_id
 FROM tb_exam_batch WHERE jc IS NOT NULL AND CAST(jc AS VARCHAR)<>'' AND exam_time IS NOT NULL
), paired AS (
SELECT c.*,b.cohort_year,b.previous_batch_id,p.score_value AS previous_score,p.full_score AS previous_full_score,
 CASE WHEN c.score_value IS NULL OR p.score_value IS NULL THEN 'missing_score'
 WHEN c.full_score IS NULL OR p.full_score IS NULL OR c.full_score<=0 OR p.full_score<=0 THEN 'missing_full_score'
 WHEN c.full_score<>p.full_score THEN 'different_full_score' ELSE 'comparable' END AS comparison_status
FROM score_base c LEFT JOIN batches b ON c.exam_batch_id=b.exam_batch_id
LEFT JOIN score_base p ON p.exam_batch_id=b.previous_batch_id AND p.student_id=c.student_id AND p.subject=c.subject
), trend AS (
SELECT *,CASE WHEN comparison_status='comparable' THEN score_value-previous_score ELSE NULL END AS delta_score,
 CASE WHEN score_value IS NOT NULL AND previous_score IS NOT NULL AND full_score>0 AND previous_full_score>0
 THEN ROUND(100.0*score_value/full_score-100.0*previous_score/previous_full_score,2) ELSE NULL END AS score_rate_delta_pp
FROM paired
), gaps AS (
SELECT exam_batch_id,school_id,student_id,COUNT(score_value) AS subject_count,
 MAX(score_value)-MIN(score_value) AS raw_score_gap,
 MAX(CASE WHEN score_value IS NOT NULL AND full_score>0 AND score_value<full_score*0.60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_failed_subject
FROM trend GROUP BY exam_batch_id,school_id,student_id
), evidence AS (
SELECT t.*,g.subject_count,g.raw_score_gap,g.has_failed_subject,
 full_score*0.60 AS pass_score
FROM trend t JOIN gaps g ON t.exam_batch_id=g.exam_batch_id AND t.school_id=g.school_id AND t.student_id=g.student_id
)
SELECT exam_batch_id,exam_name,school_id,school_name,class_name,student_id,subject,score_value,full_score,pass_score,
 previous_batch_id,previous_score,delta_score,'critical' AS risk_type,'draft_pass60_margin5_regress10_gap20' AS threshold_version,
 raw_score_gap,comparison_status
FROM evidence WHERE full_score>0 AND score_value>=pass_score-5 AND score_value<pass_score+5
UNION ALL
SELECT exam_batch_id,exam_name,school_id,school_name,class_name,student_id,subject,score_value,full_score,pass_score,
 previous_batch_id,previous_score,delta_score,'regression','draft_pass60_margin5_regress10_gap20',raw_score_gap,comparison_status
FROM evidence WHERE comparison_status='comparable' AND delta_score<=-10
UNION ALL
SELECT exam_batch_id,exam_name,school_id,school_name,class_name,student_id,subject,score_value,full_score,pass_score,
 previous_batch_id,previous_score,delta_score,'raw_gap_imbalance','draft_pass60_margin5_regress10_gap20',raw_score_gap,comparison_status
FROM evidence WHERE subject_count>=2 AND raw_score_gap>=20 AND has_failed_subject=1 AND score_value IS NOT NULL

views.statement:
-- V40 优秀良好低分率与互斥水平分层：SQL草案，尚待业务确认。
-- 使用原始tb_*逻辑模型；本次未查询真实业务库。
-- 草案口径：85%优秀、70%良好、40%低分为源码默认，含等于优秀/良好、不含等于低分边界
-- 草案口径：每学校科目一行：优秀良好为累计率，ABCD互斥档通过a_count/b_count/c_count/d_count另列，不按档分组改变率分母
-- 草案口径：真实0保留，缺成绩/缺满分为unclassified，不把缺分当D
WITH base AS (
SELECT sc.id AS score_id, sc.student_id, sc.exam_id AS paper_id,
       e.exam_batch_id, eb.batch_name AS exam_name, eb.exam_time AS exam_date,
       sc.school_id, sch.s_name AS school_name, sch.district,
       sch.type AS school_type, sc."class" AS class_name, e.subject,
       CAST(sc.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS score_value,
       CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS full_score,
       CASE WHEN sc.score IS NULL OR e.exam_score IS NULL
                      OR CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) <= 0 THEN NULL
            WHEN CAST(sc.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) >= CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) * 0.60
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pass_flag
FROM tb_score sc
LEFT JOIN tb_exam e ON sc.exam_id = e.id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_batch eb ON e.exam_batch_id = eb.id
LEFT JOIN tb_school sch ON sc.school_id = sch.id
), classified AS (
SELECT *,CASE WHEN score_value IS NULL OR full_score IS NULL OR full_score<=0 THEN 'unclassified'
 WHEN score_value>=full_score*0.85 THEN 'A' WHEN score_value>=full_score*0.70 THEN 'B'
 WHEN score_value>=full_score*0.60 THEN 'C' ELSE 'D' END AS performance_band
FROM base
)
SELECT exam_batch_id,exam_name,school_id,school_name,subject,
 COUNT(score_value) AS valid_count,COUNT(pass_flag) AS classified_count,
 SUM(CASE WHEN performance_band='A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS excellent_count,
 SUM(CASE WHEN performance_band IN ('A','B') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_count,
 SUM(CASE WHEN pass_flag IS NOT NULL AND score_value<full_score*0.40 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_count,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN performance_band='A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(pass_flag),0),2) AS excellent_rate,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN performance_band IN ('A','B') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(pass_flag),0),2) AS good_rate,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN pass_flag IS NOT NULL AND score_value<full_score*0.40 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(pass_flag),0),2) AS low_rate,
 SUM(CASE WHEN performance_band='A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS a_count,
 SUM(CASE WHEN performance_band='B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS b_count,
 SUM(CASE WHEN performance_band='C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c_count,
 SUM(CASE WHEN performance_band='D' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d_count,
 SUM(CASE WHEN performance_band='unclassified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unclassified_record_count
FROM classified GROUP BY exam_batch_id,exam_name,school_id,school_name,subject

views.name: v_tier_line_reach
views.statement:
-- V41 学校类别达线比较：SQL草案，尚待业务确认。
-- 使用原始tb_*逻辑模型；本次未查询真实业务库。
-- 草案口径：精确按COALESCE(s_name,name)匹配，名称不唯一不任取一所学校
-- 草案口径：匹配失败/歧义保留独立mapping_status，不丢候选人数、不扩行
-- 草案口径：使用当前学校类别，历史类别需后续快照维度；各线种独立汇总
WITH school_mapping AS (
SELECT COALESCE(s_name,name) AS school_label,COUNT(*) AS mapping_count,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(type) ELSE NULL END AS school_type
FROM tb_school GROUP BY COALESCE(s_name,name)
), mapped AS (
SELECT i.*,m.school_type,
 CASE WHEN m.mapping_count IS NULL THEN 'unmatched' WHEN m.mapping_count>1 THEN 'ambiguous' ELSE 'matched' END AS mapping_status
FROM tb_score_indicator i LEFT JOIN school_mapping m ON i.school_name=m.school_label
)
SELECT exam_batch_id,exam_name,school_type,mapping_status,track,line_code,line_name,
 SUM(candidates) AS candidate_count,SUM(reached_count) AS reached_count,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(reached_count)/NULLIF(SUM(candidates),0),2) AS reach_rate,
 SUM(CASE WHEN mapping_status<>'matched' THEN candidates ELSE 0 END) AS unmapped_candidate_count
FROM mapped GROUP BY exam_batch_id,exam_name,school_type,mapping_status,track,line_code,line_name

views.name: v_weak_knowledge_evidence
views.statement:
-- V42 绝对薄弱与相对薄弱知识点清单：SQL草案，尚待业务确认。
-- 使用原始tb_*逻辑模型；本次未查询真实业务库。
-- 草案口径：弱知识点60%、相对回退软上限75为旧默认
-- 草案口径：有绝对薄弱只列绝对薄弱；没有时列<75的相对项，TopN放查询层
-- 草案口径：未关联知识点不编造正式知识点名，主视图V16仍保留该组；按知识点ID稳定排序
WITH knowledge_stats AS (
WITH weights AS (
  SELECT question_id, knowledge_id,
         CAST(weight AS DOUBLE) /
         NULLIF(SUM(CAST(weight AS DOUBLE)) OVER (PARTITION BY question_id),0) AS normalized_weight
  FROM tb_exam_question_knowledge
  WHERE weight > 0
), items AS (
SELECT sd.id AS detail_id, sd.exam_id AS paper_id, sd.student_id,
       e.exam_batch_id, eb.batch_name AS exam_name,
       sc.school_id, sch.s_name AS school_name, sc."class" AS class_name,
       e.subject, sd.question_id, sd.question_no, eq.question_type,
       CAST(sd.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS item_score,
       CAST(COALESCE(eq.question_score,sd.question_score) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS item_full_score
FROM tb_score_detail sd
JOIN tb_score sc ON sd.exam_id=sc.exam_id AND sd.student_id=sc.student_id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam e ON sd.exam_id=e.id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_batch eb ON e.exam_batch_id=eb.id
LEFT JOIN tb_school sch ON sc.school_id=sch.id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_question eq ON sd.question_id=eq.id AND sd.exam_id=eq.exam_id
)
SELECT i.exam_batch_id, i.exam_name, i.school_id, i.school_name, i.class_name, i.subject,
       w.knowledge_id, COALESCE(k.knowledge_name,'未关联知识点') AS knowledge_name,
       k.ability_level,
       COUNT(DISTINCT i.question_id) AS question_count,
       COUNT(*) AS observed_item_count,
       SUM(i.item_score*COALESCE(w.normalized_weight,1)) AS weighted_score,
       SUM(i.item_full_score*COALESCE(w.normalized_weight,1)) AS weighted_full_score,
       ROUND(100.0*SUM(i.item_score*COALESCE(w.normalized_weight,1)) /
             NULLIF(SUM(i.item_full_score*COALESCE(w.normalized_weight,1)),0),2) AS mastery_rate
FROM items i
LEFT JOIN weights w ON i.question_id=w.question_id
LEFT JOIN tb_knowledge k ON w.knowledge_id=k.id
WHERE i.item_score IS NOT NULL AND i.item_full_score > 0
GROUP BY i.exam_batch_id, i.exam_name, i.school_id, i.school_name, i.class_name, i.subject,
         w.knowledge_id, k.knowledge_name, k.ability_level
), tagged AS (
SELECT *,SUM(CASE WHEN mastery_rate<60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER(PARTITION BY exam_batch_id,school_id,class_name,subject) AS absolute_weak_count,
 ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY exam_batch_id,school_id,class_name,subject ORDER BY mastery_rate,knowledge_id NULLS LAST) AS priority_rank
FROM knowledge_stats WHERE knowledge_id IS NOT NULL AND mastery_rate IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT *,60.0 AS weak_threshold,
 CASE WHEN mastery_rate<60 THEN 'absolute' ELSE 'relative' END AS weak_type
FROM tagged WHERE mastery_rate<60 OR (absolute_weak_count=0 AND mastery_rate<75)

properties.displayName: 绝对薄弱与相对薄弱知识点清单
properties.description: 绝对薄弱与相对薄弱知识点清单。输出粒度：批次×学校/班级×科目×知识点×标签类型。默认掌握率<60为绝对薄弱；无绝对薄弱时可回退最低若干项且软上限通常75；等级85/70/60独立。输出标签依据，展示Top8/Top5留查询层。 数据范围：先按所需班级/学校范围计算掌握率，再外层选阈值/前N。空组返回NULL；百分率为0–100，分母为0返回NULL。 正式发布前需确认：先确认V16缺小题口径；薄弱阈值60未由用户确认；相对薄弱不能说成不及格；禁止知识点名称编造 本SQL草案采用：弱知识点60%、相对回退软上限75为旧默认；有绝对薄弱只列绝对薄弱；没有时列<75的相对项，TopN放查询层；未关联知识点不编造正式知识点名，主视图V16仍保留该组；按知识点ID稳定排序。

views.name: v_class_local_metric_rank
views.statement:
-- V43 班级总览同校年级指标排名：SQL草案，尚待业务确认。
-- 使用原始tb_*逻辑模型；本次未查询真实业务库。
-- 草案口径：均分/及格率/优秀率独立顺序编号，同分用班名稳定排序，不冒充RANK并列
-- 草案口径：对照为各班指标等权且含本班，至少2班才给名次；年级不识别不混排
-- 草案口径：优秀85%是待确认草案默认，及格60%、真实0保留
WITH base AS (
SELECT sc.id AS score_id, sc.student_id, sc.exam_id AS paper_id,
       e.exam_batch_id, eb.batch_name AS exam_name, eb.exam_time AS exam_date,
       sc.school_id, sch.s_name AS school_name, sch.district,
       sch.type AS school_type, sc."class" AS class_name, e.subject,
       CAST(sc.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS score_value,
       CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS full_score,
       CASE WHEN sc.score IS NULL OR e.exam_score IS NULL
                      OR CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) <= 0 THEN NULL
            WHEN CAST(sc.score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) >= CAST(e.exam_score AS DECIMAL(18,4)) * 0.60
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS pass_flag
FROM tb_score sc
LEFT JOIN tb_exam e ON sc.exam_id = e.id
LEFT JOIN tb_exam_batch eb ON e.exam_batch_id = eb.id
LEFT JOIN tb_school sch ON sc.school_id = sch.id
), graded AS (
SELECT *,CASE WHEN class_name LIKE '高一%' THEN '高一' WHEN class_name LIKE '高二%' THEN '高二' WHEN class_name LIKE '高三%' THEN '高三' WHEN class_name LIKE '初一%' THEN '初一' WHEN class_name LIKE '初二%' THEN '初二' WHEN class_name LIKE '初三%' THEN '初三' ELSE NULL END AS grade,
 CASE WHEN score_value IS NULL OR full_score IS NULL OR full_score<=0 THEN NULL WHEN score_value>=full_score*0.85 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS excellent_flag
FROM base
), class_stats AS (
SELECT exam_batch_id,exam_name,school_id,school_name,grade,class_name,subject,
 COUNT(score_value) AS n,AVG(score_value) AS class_avg,
 STDDEV_SAMP(CAST(score_value AS DOUBLE)) AS class_stdev,MAX(score_value)-MIN(score_value) AS score_range,
 100.0*SUM(pass_flag)/NULLIF(COUNT(pass_flag),0) AS pass_rate,
 100.0*SUM(excellent_flag)/NULLIF(COUNT(excellent_flag),0) AS excellent_rate
FROM graded WHERE grade IS NOT NULL AND class_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY exam_batch_id,exam_name,school_id,school_name,grade,class_name,subject
), metrics AS (
SELECT exam_batch_id,exam_name,school_id,school_name,grade,class_name,subject,n,'average_score' AS metric_name,CAST(class_avg AS DOUBLE) AS metric_value FROM class_stats WHERE n>0
UNION ALL
SELECT exam_batch_id,exam_name,school_id,school_name,grade,class_name,subject,n,'pass_rate',pass_rate FROM class_stats WHERE n>0
UNION ALL
SELECT exam_batch_id,exam_name,school_id,school_name,grade,class_name,subject,n,'excellent_rate',excellent_rate FROM class_stats WHERE n>0
), ranked AS (
SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY exam_batch_id,school_id,grade,subject,metric_name) AS class_count,
 ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY exam_batch_id,school_id,grade,subject,metric_name ORDER BY metric_value DESC NULLS LAST,class_name) AS provisional_rank,
 AVG(metric_value) OVER(PARTITION BY exam_batch_id,school_id,grade,subject,metric_name) AS peer_equal_weight_value
FROM metrics WHERE metric_value IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT *,CASE WHEN class_count>=2 THEN provisional_rank ELSE NULL END AS row_number_rank
FROM ranked

properties.displayName: 班级总览同校年级指标排名
properties.description: 班级总览同校年级指标排名。输出粒度：批次×学校×年级×班级×科目×指标。原班级总览按均分/及格率/优秀率分别降序顺序编号，基准为各班对应值等权平均；不同于DENSE_RANK薄弱学科或全市RANK。 数据范围：明确同校同年级；学校班级先统一格式；参数决定排名指标。空组返回NULL；百分率为0–100，分母为0返回NULL。 正式发布前需确认：同分是否继续顺序编号；不足2班禁止静默跨年级回退；优秀比例需确认；对照含不含本班 本SQL草案采用：均分/及格率/优秀率独立顺序编号，同分用班名稳定排序，不冒充RANK并列；对照为各班指标等权且含本班，至少2班才给名次；年级不识别不混排；优秀85%是待确认草案默认，及格60%、真实0保留。
